title: Tokens are not stored in the browser; a reload restores the session from an httpOnly cookie
detail: authStore keeps the access token in memory only (no persist, no localStorage); sessionStorage holds only a flag with no token, and lib/session.ts restores via the refresh cookie. Refresh requests are de-duplicated and a failed refresh clears state and the query cache. Access is also checked on the server; tab guards in the UI are display only.

title: The one XSS-prone sink is escaped
detail: The only window.open / document.write is the result-sheet print window; every data value in its HTML goes through esc() (employee name, code, department, domains, competencies). No dangerouslySetInnerHTML or innerHTML anywhere in src. Source maps are not shipped.

title: CI order is safe: scan, quality gate, Sonar gate, then image build
detail: Both pipelines run gitleaks, lint, type-check, tests with coverage, build, Sonar with qualitygate.wait before any docker push. The frontend also runs check:css and the project's own defect-class audit. Login uses --password-stdin. Dated and short-sha tags are pushed for every production image.

title: Cache headers and API proxy in the frontend nginx are well thought out
detail: index.html is no-store, /assets/ is immutable for a year, unhashed files revalidate; nginx/nginx.conf has TLS 1.2+, HSTS, a 10 req/min login limit zone and a 1 MB body cap.

title: Backups and restores avoid hard-coded secrets and verify integrity
detail: backup and restore scripts use an AWS profile, a SHA-256 checksum uploaded beside the dump, set -euo pipefail and clear failure messages. No curl-to-shell or chmod 777 in the scripts. Deploy scripts pin tags by argument and run prisma migrate deploy (not db push).

title: Clean test hygiene
detail: No skipped or disabled tests in frontend src, e2e or backend src (0 matches for skip/fixme/xdescribe/it.todo). Frontend has 136 test files; vitest is configured with all:true so untested files count in coverage. Playwright specs are kept out of vitest.

title: Data-truth rules are mostly followed in the frontend
detail: Math.random is used only for row/toast keys, not figures. Only 6 numeric fallbacks (`?? n` / `|| n`) exist outside tests and only one (AIInsightsTab:984) is a display fallback. CSV export uses emp_code. Keyboard: 0 clickable divs without role or key handler. Modal has role=dialog and Escape.

title: Dev compose does not publish the API port
detail: deployments/docker-compose.dev.yml uses expose instead of ports for the API, and image healthchecks exist in both Dockerfiles (Node fetch, wget).
